tasks.problem_statement: Static audit of routes, components, unreachable AI modules, and server endpoints without modifying production code.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All 121 src modules classified by reachability; every AI module explicitly marked PRESERVE_AND_REHOME; server endpoints documented.

tasks.problem_statement: Concept: Dual palette split-brain. Evidence: Legacy forest green (#17634f / #143d36 / #0c1b17) renders inside blue cobalt shell (#0867E8 / #0b132b / #F7FAFF) and dark mode produces white-on-white header text in StoreV5Pane. User consequence: Broken visual hierarchy and unreadable dark-mode chrome. Root-cause hypothesis: Two unmerged CSS token sheets plus partial dark-mode overrides. Proposed verification: Unify tokens to single palette and measure contrast >= 4.5:1.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 100% UI tokens sourced from one palette; zero contrast ratios below 4.5:1 across light and dark themes.

tasks.problem_statement: Concept: Navigation redundancy and disappearing routes. Evidence: Sidebar hides Ficha & Produtos after onboardingCompleted=true (Sidebar.tsx:41-45), lacks dual view, App.tsx has unreachable activeMenu==='connect' branch, and .cg-topbar-shortcut hides at <=1100px (index.css). User consequence: Users lose direct access to their business form and see duplicate topbar/sidebar controls. Root-cause hypothesis: Iterative topbar shortcuts bolted onto legacy sidebar without consolidation. Proposed verification: Fixed 4-pillar navigation accessible at 1440px and 390px.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Zero disappearing navigation items; navigation click-to-target <= 2 clicks across all viewports; zero orphan route states.

tasks.problem_statement: Concept: Split catalog persistence and contradictory connection booleans. Evidence: SKUs added via WhatsAppView (/api/skus/adicionar) update skus.json without updating profile.json catalog used by StoreV5Pane & DashboardView; Dual View simultaneously shows Abra para detectar and Conectado. User consequence: Storefront and Dashboard show 0 products while bot holds SKUs, plus conflicting online indicators. Root-cause hypothesis: Dual write paths and 4 uncoordinated status booleans. Proposed verification: Assert single write path via profile.json and deterministic derived connection enum.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Catalog mutations synchronize bi-directionally within single revision; zero simultaneous conflicting WhatsApp status pills.

tasks.problem_statement: Concept: Identical generic storefront structure across business sectors. Evidence: synthesizeStoreFromProfile (profile-adapter.ts:240-292) outputs only header, hero:split, features:cards, categoryTiles:pills, catalog:grid, contact:panel, footer:standard regardless of segment. User consequence: Clinics, schools, hardware stores, distributors, bakeries, pharmacies, and pet shops receive identical e-commerce grids lacking booking, B2B tiers, or quote workflows. Root-cause hypothesis: Unused dynamic-synthesizer modules and static section array. Proposed verification: Render 7 sector-specific Experience Signatures validated at 1440px and 390px.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All 7 target business sectors map to distinct functional modules; 0px horizontal overflow; all touch controls >= 44px.

tasks.problem_statement: Concept: Cognitive overload and undersized touch targets in existing workspace. Evidence: 32px/34px/36px buttons and 11px-13px body labels dominate core flows alongside 4 duplicate business config forms. User consequence: High tap error probability and fragmented mental model. Root-cause hypothesis: Organic feature accretion across green and blue generations. Proposed verification: Screenshot interactive Variant A and Variant B prototypes with 44px minimum controls and 0px overflow.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Variant A >= 8.0 and Variant B >= 8.5 weighted score; sub44=0; sub14=0; overflow=0px.

tasks.problem_statement: Concept: Idle polling amplification, no-op dashboard filters, and unexposed PATCH /api/orders API. Evidence: App.tsx:193 (5s) and WhatsAppView.tsx:417 (2s) overlap on /api/whatsapp/api/dados; DashboardView period selector does not filter backend metrics; PATCH /api/orders has zero frontend caller. User consequence: Unnecessary local/server traffic, misleading filter dropdown, and missing order fulfillment workflow. Root-cause hypothesis: Independent polling hooks and incomplete dashboard frontend wiring. Proposed verification: Isolated Playwright QA execution capturing API trace and 409 lock behavior.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Full TC-01..TC-13 telemetry captured cleanly in isolated harness without touching Supabase or live WhatsApp.

tasks.problem_statement: Synthesize prioritized backlog, phased roadmap with rollback plan, scorecard >= 8.5, and Experience Manager approval gate review.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Zero unsupported claims; zero banned subjective adjectives in acceptance criteria; all AI features preserved.
